brief: You're in the main plaza of a small Mexican town and ask Lucía the way to the bus station before the last bus leaves.

cast.description: Older woman in her 60s wearing a blue rebozo

cast.name: Don Pablo
cast.description: Middle-aged man in his 50s wearing a straw hat and guayabera

cast.name: Marisol
cast.description: Young woman in her 20s wearing a yellow market apron
